name: paint_faces
description: Paint features onto specific cube faces using coordinates RELATIVE to each face (so [0,0] is that face's top-left corner) — no manual UV math, which is what usually causes misplaced/garbled texture. Use it for eyes, nostrils, mouths, claws, fur tufts, stripes, scars, bandages, armour trim, etc. Either pass one {cube, face, base?, ops?} or a `faces` array of them.

base.description: Optional solid fill for the face before ops (CSS color).

face.description: Face direction 'north'|'south'|'east'|'west'|'up'|'down', an array of them, or 'all' (single-face form).

faces.description: Batch form: array of {cube, face, base?, ops?, texture?} items.

ops.description: Paint ops (same types as paint_texture), coords relative to the face.

texture.description: Texture to paint on / assign (defaults to the face's texture or the default).
